scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
Agent researched a disjoint batch; integration and structural checks are not independent historical certification.
Imported border coordinates remain unchanged. Historical events and map coverage are distinguished in prose; see batchIdentityNotes for conflicts.

proposedOverrides.summary: A cautious guide to a mismapped layer and the changing medieval worlds around it.

batchIdentityNotes: The exact Sindh polygon is a generated editorial layer, not the modern Pakistani province and not a surveyed Habbarid border.
The polygon includes tested Thar and Kutch points but excludes every tested Indus urban center, including Mansura and Banbhore.
Mansura, Multan, Banbhore, Kutch, and rural communities are localized separately; court and urban sources are never treated as uniform regional life.
The exact id disappears at 1000, before either cited Habbarid endpoint, so fell remains null and no single successor is invented.
